title: Mutual Legal Assistance Criminal Matters Amendment Act 2021

sections.shortTitle: Mutual Legal Assistance Criminal Matters Amendment Act 2021
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE MUTUAL LEGAL ASSISTANCE (CRIMINAL MATTERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021
THE
MUTUAL LEGAL ASSISTANCE (CRIMINAL MATTERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021
[AS PASSED BY THE NATIONAL ASSEMBLY]
A
BILL
to
amend the Mutual Legal Assistance (Criminal Matters) Act, 2020
WHEREAS
it
is expedient to amend the Mutual Legal Assistance (Criminal Matters) Act, 2020
(Act XXII of 2020), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement. (1) This Act shall be called the Mutual
Legal Assistance (Criminal Matters) (Amendment) Act, 2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
